newsitem.title: LATVIA: PARLIAMENT STRIPS KRISBERGS OF IMMUNITY.
newsitem.headline: PARLIAMENT STRIPS KRISBERGS OF IMMUNITY.

text.p: Parliament on Monday stripped MP Valdis Krisbergs of his parliamentary immunity after he was accused of fraud by the prosecutor's office, politicians said.
Krisbergs, a former businessman, had been accused of large scale fraud and falsifying accounts.
"I doubt whether there is any other way for me to prove my innocence other than going through a court hearing," Krisbergs told parliament.
Krisbergs owned the bankrupt Auseklitis company, in which people lost their savings after depositing money with the company on the promise of high returns.
Krisbergs blames his successors in the company management for any irregularities.
Krisbergs entered the parliament on the list of the Democratic Party Saimnieks, but severed his links with it in the wake of the fraud allegations.
